parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier, compound name, and canonical SMILES for all molecules referenced in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, and inner join compound_structures on molregno to ensure SMILES are present. Filter by document ChEMBL ID. Order results by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
